scope: Cozia Monastery’s Church of the Holy Trinity, enclosed main ranges and terraced Olt riverfront in its documented November 2009 form.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Describes the central church, alterations and surviving carved details.
Gives the trilobed church plan, approximate 8.7 by 10 m central nave, flanking barrel vaults and layered exterior ornament.
Identifies the named church and historic monastery on the Olt at Călimănești.

terrain.basis: Original unmasked Terrarium field frozen before geometry. The Olt riverbank sits below the church court and supplies separate exterior wall base control.
